about: Borite 3249A208 (McMaster) 3/4 in shank boring bar with a TPMT-221 insert: one welded CAD solid, no colours. Black-oxide steel bar; the insert at the -x tip by a box (it stands on the bar's flat, rake face toward +y).
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; single-sided, wound as the CAD has it: its winding agrees with the CAD's own normals on 100.0% of the area, and re-winding (normals_make_consistent) would turn 5% inward

... less the bar's own chip face (y = 0), 0.2 mm under the insert's rake face, which that box crosses

boring_insert.about: an uncoated carbide TPMT insert (and its screw): carbide grey
